home_title: Speeedy: Free Online Speed Reader, No Account
home_description: Paste text or open a PDF, EPUB or DOCX and read it word by word at a pace you choose. Free, open source, no account, nothing uploaded.
home_lead: Paste text or open a file and read it one word at a time, at a pace you choose.
home_drop_hint: Or drop a file on this panel.
home_alternative: A free, open-source alternative to Spreeder
home_facts_title: Your text stays on your device.
home_fact_account: No account. Open the page and read.
home_fact_local: Files and pasted text are read in your browser. Nothing you read is uploaded.
home_fact_open: Open source under the MIT license.
seo_og_alt: The Speeedy wordmark on a pale background, with a red vertical line through it.
newsletter_building: What I'm building: also send me notes on the author's other projects
newsletter_promise: About once a month, never more. You confirm by email first. No tracking pixels, no tracked links. One click unsubscribes.
newsletter_done: Check your inbox and confirm your address. Nothing is sent until you do.
newsletter_rate_limited: Too many tries from your connection. Try again in a minute.
newsletter_failed: That did not go through. Try again in a minute.
newsletter_address: [Mailing address placeholder: the owner fills this in before launch]
reader_text_placeholder: Paste or type the text you want to read.
reader_drop_hint: Or drop a TXT file on this panel.
reader_drop_active: Drop the file to read it.
reader_shared_notice: Shared text from a link. Speeedy didn't write it.
share_lead: Turn text into a link others can speed read. The text travels inside the link, after the #. Browsers never send that part to a server, so Speeedy never sees it.
share_text_placeholder: Paste or type the text you want to share.
share_cap: A Share Link holds up to 16,384 characters once compressed: about 5,000 words of English, fewer in other scripts.
share_used: {percent}% of the Share Link size limit.
share_empty: Paste some text to share first.
share_too_long: Too long for a Share Link: this text needs {percent}% of the size limit. Shorten it and try again.
share_broken: This Share Link is broken or incomplete. Ask the sender for a new one.
share_link_too_long: This Share Link is too long to open. Ask the sender for a shorter one.
app_shell_note: This screen is a client-only shell. It loads in your browser and nothing here is indexed.
library_empty_lead: Paste or drop a text above and it stays here, with your place in it. Or try a sample.
library_error_storage: Speeedy could not reach the Library on this device.
